comment: Maps VicPoint_Spend_Master (sheet Master) onto tracker section ids. Category (Materials, Labour, Fees, and so on) does not choose a section. Pre-2025 lines are kept on these ids and are not marked excluded; the tracker drops them from totals because the date is before 1 Jan 2025. Match_Status duplicate_confirmed is left out: Jeremy confirmed those two John Puna labour lines duplicate bank payments already in the log.

masterPhaseNote.P1 Market-ready Vic Point (2023): Pre-2025. Original section ids, not counted.
masterPhaseNote.P1b Vic Point investment / tenant period: Pre-2025 side access refunds, not counted.
masterPhaseNote.P6 Move to Prescoter + early outdoor: Vic Point 2025. Section comes from Used_For, then the line overrides.
masterPhaseNote.P7 Retaining wall (John Puna) + Pointfor: Street Presence, except Pointform INV-358 (granny flat) and the hardwood posts (pool fence).
masterPhaseNote.P8 Mid outdoor / SEQ AC / Nuway: Side access, Street Presence landscaping, air con, and the small IKEA lines.
masterPhaseNote.P9 Pool coping (Project Dream Pools): Pool coping, plus three small side-access lines.
masterPhaseNote.P10 Concrete prep / Zac Knight labour: Slab split, pool bench, and the front wall lines.
masterPhaseNote.P11 Kitchen + laundry (IKEA): Order 234146073 is split. Later IKEA lines stay on the kitchen.
masterPhaseNote.Ops (excluded): Not Vic Point reno spend. Omitted.

zoneToSection.Split 70/30 pool/side: Two lines: 70% decking (rolls up to Pool & Outdoor Living) and 30% side-access.
zoneToSection.Pool area: Pool rollup (coping, decking, or pool-fence) unless a line override sends it to granny-flat.
zoneToSection.Front yard / granny flat (not this proje: exterior for the front wall and 2025+ landscaping. side-access when Used_For is General/unclear.
zoneToSection.Excluded - pre-2024: Original section id. Not counted, because the date is before 2025.

categoryNote: Ignored. Category does not map to a section id.

receiptWhenUsedFor.Purchase inspections: Purchase inspection — not a works phase
receiptWhenUsedFor.Granny flat entrance (concrete): Granny flat entrance — not a main-house phase
